body.title: Implement dead-owner reclaim inside shared acquireRunFileGuard
body.summary: Implement the reclaim in the EEXIST branch of acquireRunFileGuard (src/shared/daemon-run-files.ts): add the optional ProcessIdentityReader third param, read ownerRecord, compute processIdentityState plus the boot-id comparison ('gone', or recorded boot segment differs from the current boot), rename the stale guard to '<path>.quarantine-<UTC-timestamp>-<recorded-nonce>' with incremented-suffix collision handling, append a best-effort recovery line to PATHS.daemonLog (failures swallowed), retry mkdirSync once and recompute the conflict on retry EEXIST. Add renameSync/appendFileSync to the fs import; narrow the comments at :51 and :73 to the unverifiable-owner case.
acceptanceChecks: acquireRunFileGuard signature matches the LLD contract with optional read param
Verdict + boot-segment comparison implemented and only 'gone' or previous-boot mismatch reclaims
Stale guard renamed whole with owner.json intact; one daemonLog line; single mkdir retry; retry EEXIST recomputes the conflict and throws
Comments at :51 and :73 narrowed; borrowRunFileGuard and removeOwnedRunFile untouched

tests.name: the t1 decision-table suite turns green against the implementation (no new tests)
